info.title: IHP Event Group Chat - extracted from user-supplied OpenAPI

post.description: Verified providers and clinic admins only; patients get 403. Every group is linked to a program, an appointment series or a care episode (`context_type` + `context_id`). The creator is the owner. The name must not contain a patient's name or a health condition (422). Each invitee gets an invitation and is **not** a member, and sees nothing, until they accept.

get.description: Groups the caller is an active member of. `archived=true` lists the ones they archived (use `PATCH /conversations/{id}/archive`).

get.summary: Events I can start a group for
get.description: Step 1 of creating an event group. The Enterprise Admin's own enterprise's events (never another enterprise's), with the number of online registrants (confirmed or attended) and of groups each already has. `can_create_group` is true for a published or completed event. 403 for anyone who is not an Enterprise Admin.

get.summary: Registrants of an event to invite (searchable, paged)
get.description: Step 2. Each row has the platform `user_id` to invite (null = no chat account found, `can_invite` false), the registration and payment status, `can_invite` with a `reason`, and `group_state` (none | invited | member | declined | left | removed). Eligible = online registration `confirmed` or `attended`, payment `paid` or `free`, with an account, one per person. Walk-ins are never listed (`walk_in_excluded` counts them). `q` searches name and email. By default only people who can be invited are listed; `eligible_only=false`, `registration_status` or `payment_status` shows the others with the reason. `not_in_group=true` hides everyone already in or invited to a group of this event (or to `group_id`). Without `group_id` the list is for a NEW group (`can_invite` ignores other groups); with `group_id` it is about that group (`already_member` / `already_invited`). 403 unless the caller is the Enterprise Admin of the enterprise that owns the event (Providers, speakers, the Super Admin and attendees never manage an event group).

get.summary: Verified Providers I can add to an event group
get.description: Step 3. The enterprise's verified Providers, who join as ordinary members (never admins). Speakers and organisers typed into the event form are text only: nobody is added from them. 403 unless the caller is the Enterprise Admin of the enterprise that owns the event (Providers, speakers, the Super Admin and attendees never manage an event group).

get.summary: Groups already made for an event
get.description: Every group of this event, open and closed (details only, never messages of a group the caller is not in). 403 unless the caller is the Enterprise Admin of the enterprise that owns the event (Providers, speakers, the Super Admin and attendees never manage an event group).

post.summary: Event groups: invite registrants without sending every id
post.description: Owner of a group linked to an event (the Enterprise Admin of the owning enterprise; checked again on every call). Send `user_ids` (each must have an eligible registration for the event, or be a verified Provider of the enterprise; otherwise 422 `INVITEE_NOT_ELIGIBLE` with `invalid_user_ids` and a `reasons` entry for each) or `all_eligible: true` (everyone eligible, one per person, who is not in or invited to this group, oldest registration first, up to the free places). Someone already a member or already invited is skipped (`skipped`), never invited twice. `not_invited_group_full` counts the people left out because the group is full: make another group for them. A full group refuses new named invitations (409). Use it again later to invite people who registered afterwards.

name.title: Name
name.description: Must not contain a patient's name or a health condition.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: care = one patient's care team; program = several patients in one program.

avatar_url.title: Avatar Url
avatar_url.description: The group icon: the `url` returned by POST /api/v1/uploads/ (for example /api/v1/uploads/group-avatars/ab12.png), or an https:// address. Anything else is a 422.

context_type.title: Context Type
context_type.description: Every group follows a program, an appointment series or a care episode.

admins_only_posting.title: Admins Only Posting
admins_only_posting.description: Default: on for a program group, off for a care group.

invite_all_enrolled.title: Invite All Enrolled
invite_all_enrolled.description: Training groups only: also invite every eligible enrolled learner of the training, up to the group limit (the people in `invitees` come first). The answer is the group; `GET /groups/{id}/members` shows who was invited.

invite_all_registered.title: Invite All Registered
invite_all_registered.description: Event groups only: also invite every eligible registrant of the event (confirmed or attended online registration, paid or free, one per person), up to the group limit (the people in `invitees` come first). The answer is the group; `GET /groups/{id}/members` shows who was invited.

exclude_user_ids.title: Exclude User Ids
exclude_user_ids.description: With invite_all_enrolled / invite_all_registered: people to leave out.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: The name other patients will see in a program group. The invited person can change it when they accept.

is_minor.title: Is Minor
is_minor.description: Under 18: the invitation must be accepted with a parent's or guardian's consent.

context_name.title: Context Name
context_name.description: Training and event groups: the title of the linked training or event.

member_count.title: Member Count
member_count.description: Active members: the people who can see this group.

visibility_notice.title: Visibility Notice
visibility_notice.description: "N people can see this" - show it on every group.

screenshots_blocked.title: Screenshots Blocked
screenshots_blocked.description: A hint to the app: block screenshots where the phone allows it.

permissions.description: What the caller can do with this group. Use it instead of working permissions out from my_role.

can_post.title: Can Post
can_post.description: Send a message (false when closed, muted, or posting is for providers only and the caller is not one).

can_edit_group.title: Can Edit Group
can_edit_group.description: Change the name, description and picture (PATCH /groups/{id}).

can_view_pending_invitations.title: Can View Pending Invitations
can_view_pending_invitations.description: The members list also returns people who were invited and have not answered.

can_remove_admin.title: Can Remove Admin
can_remove_admin.description: Take admin away from someone (owner or compliance; a reason is required).

can_hide_messages.title: Can Hide Messages
can_hide_messages.description: Remove any message from view, with a reason.

can_reopen.title: Can Reopen
can_reopen.description: The group is closed and the caller is its owner or compliance.

can_leave.title: Can Leave
can_leave.description: Any active member except the owner (who hands the group over first).

can_withdraw_consent.title: Can Withdraw Consent
can_withdraw_consent.description: Take consent back (POST /groups/{id}/consent/withdraw). Same rule as can_leave: false for the owner, who must hand the group over first (otherwise 409).

can_mute_group.title: Can Mute Group
can_mute_group.description: Mute notifications or pin the group for myself (PATCH /groups/{id}/preferences).

GroupPermissions.title: GroupPermissions
GroupPermissions.description:
What the caller can do with this group right now. Built by the server from the caller's role, the kind of member
they are, whether the group is open and the group's posting rules, so the app does not have to work it out.

registered_count.title: Registered Count
registered_count.description: Confirmed or attended online registrations (walk-ins excluded). Payment is checked in the attendees list, not here.

group_count.title: Group Count
group_count.description: Open and closed groups already linked to this event.

can_create_group.title: Can Create Group
can_create_group.description: true for a published or completed event.

eligible_total.title: Eligible Total
eligible_total.description: Registrations of the event that could be invited, whatever the filters.

walk_in_excluded.title: Walk In Excluded
walk_in_excluded.description: Walk-in registrations: never part of Event Group Chat, never listed.

max_members.title: Max Members
max_members.description: The group limit, owner and pending invitations included.

email.title: Email
email.description: For the enterprise's staff, as in the attendee list.

payment_status.title: Payment Status
payment_status.description: free | paid | unpaid | pending | failed | cancelled | refund_requested | refunded (derived from the paired order).

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The registrant's platform user id: the id to invite. null = no chat account found, `can_invite` false.

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: Groups of this event the person is invited to or a member of.

user_ids.title: User Ids
user_ids.description: Invite exactly these registrants (and verified providers).

all_eligible.title: All Eligible
all_eligible.description: Invite every eligible registrant who is not already in or invited to this group, up to the free places.

exclude_user_ids.title: Exclude User Ids
exclude_user_ids.description: With all_eligible: people to leave out.

InviteRegistered.title: InviteRegistered
InviteRegistered.description: Invite registrants of an event group's event without sending thousands of ids.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Already active, already invited, or the caller.

not_invited_group_full.title: Not Invited Group Full
not_invited_group_full.description: Eligible learners left out because the group reached its limit. Make another group for them.

no_account.title: No Account
no_account.description: Eligible enrolments with no chat account (no user id could be found).

free_places.title: Free Places
free_places.description: Places left in the group after these invitations.

BearerAuth.description:
JWT **access token** for authenticated API requests.

## Primary — Invigorate Auth (Production)

1. Login: `POST https://admin.apis.invigor8.app/api/v1/auth/login`
2. Copy: `tokens.access_token` from the response
3. Click **Authorize** above and paste the token (Swagger adds `Bearer ` automatically)
4. Call any protected endpoint on this marketplace API

| Setting | Value |
|---------|-------|
| Algorithm | RS256 |
| Issuer (`iss`) | `https://auth.invigor8.app/realms/invigorate-healthcare` |
| Audience (`aud`) | `invigorate-api` **or** `azp=invigorate-api` |
| JWKS | `https://auth.invigor8.app/realms/invigorate-healthcare/protocol/openid-connect/certs` |
| User ID claim | `sub` (Keycloak user ID) |
| App User UUID | `GET /api/v1/auth/me` on auth API (different from `sub`) |

**Role claims:** `isSuperAdmin` (Platform Super Admin login → `super_admin`), `tenant_role`, `user_role`, `tenant_rbac_roles`, `tenant_permissions`

See **Authentication** → `GET /api/v1/auth/integration` for full reference.

**Dual auth (same routes, no duplicate APIs):**
- **Enterprise Admin portal** — HttpOnly cookie `access_token` (`credentials: include`)
- **Platform Super Admin portal** — `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` from dedicated Super Admin login

Both use the same JWT validation path (`get_current_user`). Public catalog GETs (products, services) remain unauthenticated.

## Fallback — Local dev token (Testing only)

`GET /api/v1/auth/dev-token` when `ENABLE_DEV_TOKEN=true` — local HS256 token, not Invigorate auth.
